label: D2: S1 reached after an S2 trial / a2 history, early episode only
explanation: Fires only at D2 and only when the reached state is S1 (100% of mass). Within that it is confined to the first ~25-30 trials of an episode (zero activity after trial ~30; rate peaks in trials 1-9), suggesting a slowly drifting hidden-state component. It fires when S1 is unexpected given the recent history: the previous trial ended in S2 (or is unknown) and the agent was on a2 (this trial a2 = rare S1, or the previous trial was a2 and it just switched to a1). Top activations are switches a2->a1 that land in S1 commonly, and a2 choices that rarely reach S1. Larger when the policy leans strongly to a2 (choice logit -9 to -4) and value is in the 7.1-7.5 band. Never fires at D1/GO, at S2, or when the reward input is nonzero. All variables are observed at D2. Dev: P 0.81, R 0.74, F1 0.77, mass recall 0.83; dropping the a2-history clause gives mass recall 0.99 at P 0.48.
